summary: The candidate is correct and self-contained. The simplex census includes every lattice boundary point, and the padding potential yields positive algebraic weights on the exact full box support with a finite-valued global log-concave extension. The positive Laurent-polynomial root exists uniquely; permutation symmetry and its defining equation give the exact original mean zero. The tilt-minimization argument bounds the total added weight after tilting, while the retained simplex bounds the interior capacity uniformly over every independent tilt. The explicit choice k = 2 times 5^n establishes all stated finite inequalities, including the n = 2 case and all closed-halfspace equality atoms. The limiting estimates prove both claimed obstructions to dimension-independent lower bounds.
